avis.titre: DO NOT BUY THIS MOISTURIZER NO MATTER WHAT YOUR SKIN TYPE!!
avis.texte: So I bought this my friend told me it was good. I was seeing everywhere and I was like OK. This is gonna be my favorite moisturizer. I WAS WRONG. I have dry skin and somehow it made me greasy… but at the same time it wasn't moisturizing. Milia is something that appears on the face when you put heavy products. IT WAS EVERYWHERE. I am still struggling to get rid of my milia. Because it isn't something that goes away fast. Tiny little white bumps everywhere. If you don't know, there is something called humectants like hyaluronic acid which is the only genuinely good ingredient in this anyway. And then there's emollients. those make sure that the humectants stay in your skin. if you don't have emollients the humectants actually make your skin drier than it was before. ALL THIS MOISTURIZER HAS IS HUMECTANTS. yet still makes me so greasy. Anyways DO NOT BUY THIS

I struggle with texture, clogged pores, and black heads. The medication I use requires a 'no active ingredients' moisturizer. I thought i found it in this moisturizer, since they advertise as non-comedogenic. This formula actually contains Oleic Acid, which is a pore clogging ingredient. I didnt realize this and my texture and black heads were awful even with my medication. When I switched to a different moisturizer without clogging ingredients, the issue stopped immediately. I suggest that if you deal with texture or clogging pores, dont use this moisturizer.

I have had the worst skin for the past year or 2 itchy, red, inflamed, dry and flaky patches and acne, finally stumbled upon a tik tok talking about Benzoyl peroxide being way better than other acne products but it's drying to the skin. As a last effort I bought Pan Oxyl's BP and I bought THIS moisturizer in hopes it would keep my skin from getting even more irritated and dry. I was terrified but when I tell you that my skin has never ever been so smooth and hydrated! I thought my skin barrier was a myth it was so damaged but I know it is being rebuilt as I use this cream. I bought this a month ago and have had no irritations. Dry patches gone, itchiness gone. My pores are shrinking. One day when I go to a lower BP I'll switch to a gel moisturizer that I hope the Ordinary comes out with bc I can tell I won't need this intense hydration forever. This is not for oily skin, do not waste your time.
